name: Fruit Story
description: Fruit Story is an AI fruit story generator for short-form 9:16 fruit dramas for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. No filming required. Generate, review, refine, and download. Official pricing at fruitstory.video/pricing lists paid-only credit packs from 7.99 USD to 499 USD and monthly Basic 29.90, Pro 49.90, Studio 99.90. No free plan listed.
